latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to Video Making — Initial Release

- Instantly convert uploaded still images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos with AI-powered transitions and animation.
- No manual editing required—just describe the video you want and get a ready-to-post video in under a minute.
- Fully cloud-based processing—no installation needed; videos are rendered on remote GPU servers.
- Supports multiple user workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and step-by-step refinements, all while preserving your project session.
- Simple onboarding with automatic anonymous authentication if no token is provided, and clear handling of uploads, credits, and exports.
- Action-oriented chat flow: just upload images and describe your goal to begin.
